blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Jean Claude Saclag earned a shot at an Asian Games gold medal after advancing to the mixed martial arts men’s traditional -65kg final in Aichi-Nagoya 2026. Saclag, who is confident that he will bring home a gold, proved that he wasn’t messing around as he took down Japanese Daisuke Murayama by unanimous decision in the semifinal on Monday at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center in Japan. Saclag takes on Otabek Rajabov of Tajikistan in the gold medal match on Tuesday afternoon. Rajabov beat Sanzhar Adilov of […]...
